reviews.title: Super Helpful!!
reviews.text: This app makes logging and tracking information for our pups super easy. The functions in the free version are enough for most needs and allow you to customize events to log, create separate logs for each pup (pack) and share with others to keep info. updated so an entire household can log entries, check info. and stay on top of a dog’s needs/care. As someone who recently lost a pup and used this app to track medications, changes in routines/activity, and have records to review with veterinarians and specialists, this app played a critical role in managing my pup’s care. Thank you for creating an app designed for managing care of our sweet doggos that intuitive and easy to use!

reviews.title: Really helpful tool!
reviews.text: My husband and I have been using DogLog since we got our puppy four months ago. Being able to quickly see when one of us last took him outside was incredibly helpful with getting him house trained. Tracking his meal times has been helpful because we work different schedules so frequently change up who is feeding when. If I get home from work late and my husband is out, I can quickly see if the pup has had supper or not. We also love that we can make custom events so we can log things like how long he’s in his kennel for if we are both gone for a while, and how often he gets the Italian greyhound zoomies. We also added family members who puppy-sit for us so they can log too. We love this app!!

reviews.title: Love the app
reviews.text:
My family and I have been using DogLog and it’s been a great experience. It helps us track everything across all family members — we weren’t always the best at communicating when someone had already done something, but now I just check my phone and it’s all right there: who walked him, who fed and watered him, when he last went to the bathroom, his weight, and so much more.

It’s taken the guesswork out of caring for our dog and made sure nothing slips through the cracks. Highly recommend to any multi-person household with a pet!

reviews.title: Love this app!

If you have a puppy, this will help you stay on top of feeding, play, and potty breaks in an easy and quick way. Love it!

reviews.title: UI is broken, no fix in 7 months
reviews.text: Most logging entries don’t show options for the entry but show options for walking. For example, the “Food” button will take you to a screen that shows you miles walked and time instead of things such as the food type you’re giving your dog or the amount of cups. It’s very frustrating because this is affecting everything in the Diet, Outdoors, and Care sections and forces me to have to add details in the notes that should already just be baked into the different buttons already. If this gets fixed then this is a superior dog logging app for iOS for many things, but it has had no developer response and you can’t even leave feedback on their website because the site is broken too (there’s another review that talks about it here). It’s shocking how much broke and even more shocking you can’t report these issues because the email form is non-functional.

reviews.title: Great App! User friendly!
reviews.text: My husband and I have been using this app since we got our dog Bella in 2022. Sometimes, mine, and my husband schedules don’t align, and this app is very helpful because it allows us to communicate when our dog has gone outside, and when we’ve fed her. It also has helped during difficult times when she had stomach upset issues. And allowed us to keep track of everything going on. The option to add a picture to each item that you’re logging is fantastic. Very simple to use and user-friendly!

reviews.title: Helpful for households with shared responsibility

reviews.title: Great tracker
reviews.text: So I downloaded this because of all the positive reviews. I have a 5 month puppy and fun trying to create a regular schedule for him to assist with potty training. So I was looking for a free app I could use to log his day to keep up with his schedule. A lot of apps claim to be free but after logging two things or even an entire day you have to purchase a subscription. Which having a pet is already super expensive so purchasing an app or paying for a subscription was out the question for me. This app so far the free version is amazing I can log his day and set reminders there aren’t pop up adds or constant notifications about purchasing a subscription which I love. There are some premium features like adding vaccinations and medical info but my complex has a required pet screening account that all residents with animals must pay for and it tracks all that so I only needed the log feature and so far I’m happy with it but it’s only been one day so I’ll update this in a week and tell you if I still feel the same.

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text:
We started using DogLog when one of our dogs was elderly and we needed to closely track her inputs and outputs.  We used it until she died and were so glad to have had it.  Two years later we got a puppy and started right up on DogLog again.  We use it daily for everything, and it was especially helpful when she’s had some GI problems.  It’s invaluable to us.  We
Have now subscribed to the premium level and it’s well worth the nominal cost.  We are so thankful for this tool, it’s easy to use, and we want to support the developers of such a thoughtful, useful product that helps us be attentive pet parents.

reviews.title: Life safer for new puppy parents!
reviews.text: As we’ve been low on sleep from waking up every few hours to take our puppy out, this app has been a life safer for keeping all details in one place. No more questioning of if we fed her, or what time we let her outside. We’re both able to add occurrences and it has been really helpful to track frequency of certain behaviors. When our puppy developed a UTI, we were able to inform our vet with specifics and trends for how often she needed to potty. This kind of information was incredibly helpful to get her the care she needed. I can’t recommend this app enough because it has been a tool that has made the first weeks of being puppy parents all the more bearable.

I was able to show the vet the DogLog. He was so pleased and he was able to see the history of what I fed the dog , the weight when she first started getting diarrhea to the weight she was now. What food I was feeding her. He said it really helped to make his diagnosis and treatment easier, and more accurate.

reviews.title: Almost Perfect!
reviews.text:
This app is so useful for our dogs. It is especially useful because we have multiple adults/teenagers at home and puppies whose bathroom routines need to be kept very regular, and this really helps! Accidents inside have decreased exponentially simply because everyone is aware when the dogs last went out and we have reminders set up to take them out after 2 hours. 

The one feature we REALLY NEED (and I would happily buy Premium if it were included!) would be an easier way to differentiate between dogs on the main feed. I know the color coding is for activities and you can filter to one pet, but it would be great to have the activities on the main feed highlighted differently for each dog or even just the names show up in different colors. It’s a bit difficult to differentiate quickly right now, and with dogs of different ages/abilities/needs we don’t have them on the same schedule. Before we leave the house I’d like to be able to quickly glance and see that all pets were fed/taken out etc without having to read as closely.

reviews.title: Love it but there’s room for improvement
reviews.text:
App is great. Does exactly what it claims to. Even without the premium features it’s fully usable. 

I wish there was the option to either auto-comment, or label things like food. So if you’re rotating flavors for your dog, you can keep tabs on what you’ve fed them recently. It’s tedious to have to comment the flavor every time and would be nice to have it auto label until you need to change the label. 

Also, although we hope our dogs don’t ever get sick, it happens. The option to record digestive issues could help track consistencies. 

Together you could find out something like “every time we switch to ____ flavor kibble, the dog gets sick for x amount of time until they adjust. Let’s remove that flavor from the rotation.”

Maybe these would need to be premium features, but I think they’d be worthwhile additions.

The main issue I’ve come across is that the reusable custom actions rearrange the order they are in on the “Log Events” page every time I reopen the app. This requires me to use extra mental energy scrolling and finding the specific actions I want to select, every time I use the app. Please make it possible to keep the actions in the same order so users can quickly find their frequently used actions.

reviews.text:
Super easy to use, even my 11 yr old does when she has her phone. 

I would love to see the ability to schedule alarms specifically being able to set alarm for certain number hours for after first pee of the day during certain window as do not want alarms in middle of nite so looking to enable alarms between 5 am - 11 pm that go off every x hrs based on first pee of the day  - ex. Logged 5:45 am pee today so since has alarms/reminders set for every 2 hours I will get alert 7:45, 9:45 etc til 11 pm. 

Would also like ability to do same think for feeding being able to set reminder to go off set number minutes after a meal is logged. 

And have these alarms/reminder go to all pack members or not but having option to turn on/off for pack members. 

I would pay for premium if this was avail as we have a problem in our house w family mbrs forgetting to take dog out on days when mom isn’t telling someone too cause she’s cleaning or gardening. If you have questions on what I mean I would be happen to answer any.

reviews.title: Downgrading after experience
reviews.text:
Initially I was wowed and really enjoyed the app.  Even made a contribution of much greater value than most apps sell for as a one time purchase fee.  It seems like the developers have gotten a little greedy from the popularity and now want $40 per year for what amounts to rather minor benefits no where near the value.
One simple thing you cannot do with the free version is download the data.  This becomes a much bigger problem than you might think, as the app doesn’t store the data locally and downloads the logs every time you open the app.  Now it takes about 3-4 minutes for the app to start up, much longer over cellular data, when you have a few thousand log entries. So short term as a free app if you are okay with waiting around a lot, or wipe out your data to start over with a new pack every 6 months or so, it can be okay.  It’s too bad as it did seem promising at first.  There is also advertising from sponsors too.

Adding a custom event is a really nice feature. As much as we try to stop her, our dog eats stuff outside. We always track it on the log so we have a timeline and know to watch her closely for a few days.

reviews.title: Best Pet Tracking App & FREE!!!
reviews.text: We have a senior dog with multiple chronic medical conditions. After over a year of trying to remember it all I finally started using a baby tracking app to try and track food, potty, and medications. It was helpful but not fully applicable for a dog. (Obv not nursing her.) Plus I wanted an app that worked across iOS & Android platforms so that hubs and I (& whomever else you have caring for your pet- ie kids, pet sitter, etc) could share info (on multiple pets if you’d like) without having to remember the specifics ourselves. It also makes it much easier to examine patterns and share info with our vet. I also love that it has the ability to add custom tracking buttons for whatever feels most helpful for your pet. The absolute best part about all of this is that’s it’s 💯% FREE!!! I cannot stand paying for an app only to find out it’s not actually useful or getting a “free” one that nickels and dimes you every time you use it. However, I am happy to pay a reasonable amount for things that prove their worth. I’m so pleased I’m going to contribute to their fundraiser to keep this app going. Good job on this app! 👍

reviews.title: Great app just need data export option
reviews.text: This is really a great app and I use it to keep track of my senior boxer and my geriatric cat. The only reason I didn’t give 5 stars is because I could really use an option to export the data into a Word document in order to get a good look at trends. Right now I am typing everything out and it can be time consuming. Doing this has been very beneficial in spotting issues before they get to be big problems.

reviews.title: Charting needs more options
reviews.text: Great app and easy to log data! The data in the charts could be much more informative and useful for recognizing your pet’s trends and progression such as bladder control. If there were an option to view the events within a 7-day view, Sunday-Saturday, where the events are color coded so it’s easy to see (for example) that food was at 1pm on Monday followed by pee at 1:30pm...and then on Tuesday food was also at 1pm but pee happened later at 2pm.

reviews.title: Lifesaver
reviews.text:
My husband and I are the proud owners of 8 critters. 4 dogs 3 cats and a mouthy fish named Moe. Several of our dogs have health problems which require medication and specialty diets as well as potty training needs. Since my husband and I both care for the animals and at times hand care off to each other,  we needed a way to track and keep track of everything related to our pack. This has helped so much.

 My only suggestions are to allow more than 3 animals in a pack. It should be unlimited. And to include other types of animals.  Which is why I gave it 4 stars instead of 5. It has room for improvements. 

We each downloaded the app to our phone and both signed into the same account which allows us to see what has been entered. It is a great benefit for our needs.

reviews.title: Incredible App!!!
reviews.text:
I never write reviews but this app deserves 10 stars if I could give that many! My dog recently had surgery and my boyfriend and I were completely overwhelmed with his discharge instructions and all the medications we needed to give him at specific times. Not to mention, all the signs/symptoms we needed to watch for such as refusing to eat or regurgitating.

Thanks to this app we were able to stay organized and track all his activities and medications. The app is user friendly and I love that we could make our own custom events for symptoms or anything else we needed to track. The reminders feature was incredibly helpful in keeping us on track with his meds.  It’s also amazing that we were able to put notes in the reminders so we could easily see not just the name of the medicine but also what it was for and whether it needed to be given with food etc. 

The customer support is also amazing! I had a question and received a response via email fairly quickly. I can’t say enough good things about this app! The best part is it’s totally free! Don’t waste your time on any other app. This one is the best if you’re needing to track your pets needs and activities.

reviews.title: Love it

reviews.title: Good so far, room for improvement
reviews.text:
The app features most functions I am looking for in monitoring our pet care with my family. The whole UI lacks some polish and could use a facelift, but is functionally working well so far. At minimum it might be nice to be able to pick some color schemes other than red.

Two requests: please include fractions in the food measurements, and allow for punctuation in the names of customized actions (and / or & can go a long way). Best of luck continuing to improve this very helpful app!

reviews.title: From a pet sitter
reviews.text:
This is a great app! Very simple and straight forward, easy to use. I have a pet sitting business and have began to implement this with my clients for easy tracking. 

I have reached out to the developers and have discussed several ideas and improvements. I was met with a warm reply and great news for the plans of the future of this app. They already planned on rolling out a few of my ideas I sent in their coming versions. I hope to see other features I recommended as well, as this could really be a game changer for small pet sitting businesses to use on a regular basis. 

For what it is, they’ve done an excellent job and I will continue to use it and look forward to their further development.
